scope: Customer immediate-transfer and asynchronous-payment browser journeys: exact money entry, explicit confirmation, replay-safe uncertainty resolution, authoritative receipts, payment history/status polling, pending cancellation, responsive layouts and authenticated accessibility. Refund/reversal, schedules, webhooks and administrator interfaces remain later P08 slices.

requirements.statement: A customer can submit an owner-authorized immediate transfer only after explicit confirmation and receives an authoritative settled receipt containing stable transfer and journal references.

A lost or ambiguous transfer/payment response preserves the normalized economic intent and original idempotency key, blocks conflicting replacement commands and resolves through safe replay without a duplicate financial effect.
Payment creation displays durable PENDING acceptance honestly and polls the owner-scoped payment resource with bounded timing until an authoritative terminal state is observed.

Payment history and detail render real incoming/outgoing direction, amount, counterparty reference, version, timestamps, adjustment state, failure information and settlement journal only when returned by the protected API.

Only an outgoing PENDING payment exposes cancellation; cancellation has its own idempotency key, preserves uncertainty safely and refreshes the authoritative resource so a settlement race is never misrepresented.

Money entry uses exact currency precision and minor-unit strings, confirmation dialogs are keyboard-operable with predictable focus, status is non-color-only, and critical flows pass axe at desktop, tablet and mobile reference widths.

The P08B browser journeys execute against the real same-origin Compose topology with PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, outbox publisher and competing payment workers while preserving the complete P01-P08A regression campaign.
